title: MEINIER DS-118 carbon road frameset
notes: The manufacturer identifies model MEINIER-DS-118 as a carbon road disc frameset in XS through XXL with a 700C maximum 32C tire, T47 86 mm bottom bracket, UDH hanger, 100x12/142x12 hubs and internal routing.
